Are two first names a direct nickname pair? (vectorised)

nickname_equivalent_vec.Rd

Direct means one is a diminutive of the other – a canonical and one of its listed variants (ROBERT/BOB). Two sibling variants of the same canonical (LISA and BETH, both from ELIZABETH) are not equivalent: a person goes by one diminutive, not both, so treating them as the same first name would wrongly merge two different people.

Usage

nickname_equivalent_vec(a, b)

Arguments

a, b

Equal-length upper-cased name vectors.

Value

Logical vector.
